raw_segments.text: Yea, go, my lord, I would I might entreat your honor to scan this thing no further.
Leave it to time, though it be fit that Cassio have his place, for sure he fills it up with
great ability, yet if you please to hold him off a while, you shall by that perceive him
Note if your lady strain his entertainment with any strong or vehement importunity, much
In the meantime, let me be thought too busy in my fears, as worthy cause I have to fear
I am, and hold her free I do beseech your honor.
